_meta.description: Sample routes for TruckPilot. The first two entries reference UIDs that exist in the synthetic 'output/graph.json' shipped with the repo (uid=1 and uid=2) and therefore work out-of-the-box with `cargo run -- --graph-json output/graph.json --start <start> --goal <goal>`. Entries 3..10 use realistic ETS2 base-map UIDs as placeholders — they are intended as a template you copy/adjust against your own full map export.
_meta.graph_source_realmap: output/graph.json (after running the .NET map export against base_map.scs)

routes.name: Synthetic Smoke 0x1 -> 0x2
routes.notes: Sanity-check route that exists in the in-repo synthetic graph.json. Use to verify cargo run wiring without a real map.

routes.name: Synthetic Reverse 0x2 -> 0x1
routes.notes: Reverse direction — currently fails on the synthetic graph because only a single forward edge exists. Useful to verify no-route handling.
